=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: US and Mexico lose measles-free status ===

[Source 1 — www.dw.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.dw.com/en/us-and-mexico-lose-measles-free-status/a-79973966?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-xml-mrss):
US and Mexico lose measles-free status

The United States lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, the Pan American Health Organization has said. Bolivia and Mexico have also lost their measles elimination status.

[Source 2 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261117-us-mexico-and-bolivia-lose-measles-free-status-as-deaths-mount):
US, Mexico and Bolivia lose measles-free status as deaths mount

The US has lost its measles-free status, international health officials said Tuesday, as the highly contagious virus has spread at the fastest rate in more than 30 years, while Mexico and Bolivia also lost their measles-elimination status. Vaccination rates have been falling against a number of diseases, in the US and globally, and measles has been spreading throughout the Americas since 2024.
